title: BNCI 2014-004 Motor Imagery dataset
description: EEG recordings from 9 healthy, BCI-naive participants performing two-class motor imagery (left vs. right hand), originally released as BCI Competition 2008 Graz data set B (BCI Competition IV Dataset 2b). Each participant completed five sessions: two screening sessions without feedback and three sessions with smiley visual feedback. Three bipolar EEG channels (C3, Cz, C4) and three EOG channels were recorded at 250 Hz.
methods_description: Participants performed kinesthetic motor imagery of left or right hand movements after an arrow cue. Screening sessions had 6 runs of 20 trials each, without feedback. Feedback sessions had 4 runs of 40 trials each, with continuous smiley feedback. Signals were recorded with g.tec amplifiers using rtsBCI (MATLAB/Simulink) at 250 Hz, with a 0.5-100 Hz bandpass and a 50 Hz notch filter. Ground was at Fz and reference at the left mastoid.
